purpose: Freeze a pre-human synthetic model-recovery and simulation-based design-search contract for the F1b source/evidence and decision/action candidate families before any participant recruitment or runtime integration.

R1.name: SOURCE_RELIABILITY_X_EVIDENCE_BELIEF_UPDATE_RECOVERY

candidate_families.interpretation: Centered anti-reliability candidate; sufficiently low T reverses signed evidence contribution.
Discount-only comparator; reliability attenuates signed evidence toward zero without sign reversal.
Threshold/gating comparator; low-reliability evidence is ignored rather than smoothly reversed.

required_discrimination: smooth weighting versus threshold gating around tau
signed evidence direction in both positive and negative conditions

R2.name: ACCURACY_X_REWARD_ACTION_POLICY_RECOVERY

candidate_families.interpretation: Current complement-interaction model: accuracy salience increases belief sensitivity while attenuating reward sensitivity.
Additive comparator without forced accuracy-reward trade-off.

candidate_families.expression: u = bias + beta_b*(2B-1) + beta_a*A + beta_r*R + beta_ab*A*(2B-1) + beta_ar*A*R
candidate_families.interpretation: Flexible interaction comparator with independently estimable accuracy×belief and accuracy×reward interactions.

required_discrimination: current complement interaction versus additive action model
current constrained interaction versus flexible interaction surface
null or near-null interaction stress conditions

crossed_random_effects.interpretation: Recovery must be tested under participant and item heterogeneity rather than only homogeneous Bernoulli observations.

selection_rule.decision: SELECT only when both prospectively declared diagnostics favor the same candidate family; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

interpretation_boundary: Passing synthetic model recovery would show only that the declared candidate mechanisms are distinguishable under the simulated design and fitting pipeline.
The participant and item grids are design-search values, not approved human sample sizes.
No candidate family becomes a true human mechanism merely because it is recoverable from synthetic data.
The current M0 source_weight(T)=2T-1 remains a testable reference candidate and is not promoted by this contract.
No F1b runtime event, EncounterContext, DecisionOpportunityEvent, or M0 equation change is authorized.

method_basis.role: pre-data parameter and model recovery for computational behavioral models
participant-by-stimulus power and optimal design with crossed random factors
pre-data parameter/model recovery workflow in computational modeling
simulation-based power analysis workflow for mixed-effects designs
